Remix Icon — @iconify-json/ri 1.2.10 (Remix Icon 4.8.0)
Apache 2.0 — https://github.com/Remix-Design/RemixIcon/blob/v4.8.0/License
(the licence of the 4.8.0 release bundled here; later Remix releases use a
different licence). Icons bundled via Iconify; selected original SVGs only.

Closest matches: a set with no glyph for a name uses the nearest one —
Material and Heroicons have no GitHub mark (a code glyph is used);
Heroicons has no circle, triangle, wave, magnet or keyboard (stop-circle,
exclamation-triangle, signal, speaker-wave and command-line are used);
Feather has no spring, infinity, magnet or flask (activity, link-2, radio
and box); Remix 4.8.0 has no magnet (sensor-line); Bootstrap has no flask
(eyedropper).
